nunquam vocati fuerunt ab ecclesiis, inani titulo ac
reditibus ecclesiasticorum gaudebant : quo solum
nomine Episcopis illis sententiæ dictio in supremis
regni Comitiis permissa fuit, quod alibi etiam in

page.notes: Spacing between "Belgii" and "Confœderati" is doubtful in the scan. The abbreviations "parl." and "stat." are read as printed, including the dots after "35" and "24". Long s was written as plain s throughout, and "eft" was read as "est". No catchword, signature or footnote is visible. A faint mark at the lower left is not printed text and was left out.
